findings.observed: Production QA and red regression showed the Listen engage CTA at 320px had a 344px right edge / document scrollWidth, caused by an intrinsic-width inline-flex pill with no max-width/wrapping constraints.
findings.resolution: Constrained the Listen engage CTA itself with border-box sizing, max-width:100%, min-width:0, normal wrapping, centered text, and overflow-wrap:anywhere; no page-level overflow hiding was added. Skills was not edited because the red run already had its Skills check passing.

findings.observed: Production QA and red regression showed overlay nav links had no aria-current, and manual scrolling did not update the hash/current state.
findings.resolution: Added token-based active section state for internal nav anchors, exactly one aria-current=location in the overlay, click/hash/popstate synchronization, and manual-scroll hash replacement via history.replaceState(window.history.state, ...) without adding entries. Pending clicked/hash targets are protected during smooth-scroll settling so intermediate sections do not replace the requested target mid-scroll.

patch.summary: Minimal implementation for UX-P1-001 and UX-P2-002: Listen CTA containment/wrapping at 320px; navigation active hash/current state and manual-scroll hash replacement while preserving real anchor hrefs and no-JS navigation; small aria-current CSS state only.
